_comment: Skill gates: observable tool events that require an agent skill to have been loaded this session. Single source of truth consumed by the shared core (~/.agents/guardrails/core.ts, createGuardrails) across Claude, Codex, pi, and opencode; matching lives in core.ts, the host adapter supplies session evidence of skill loads. Each gate's `trigger` is one of: {type:bash, command, subcommands?} | {type:write, path_glob, at_root?, except?} | {type:fetch, domains}. Every miss fails open. Add a gate here once; all agents pick it up. `message` states ONLY the event that tripped the gate — never what the skill contains; the skill name comes from `skill` and its purpose lives solely in its own description (avoids cross-source drift).
